messages:
maya: Quick bring-up snapshot for meridian-9b. Short summary: int8 gives best multi-turn fidelity; int4 saves ~28% on token cost but shows consistent recall/coherence drops on conversational slices (~8-12%). Recs below.
ev: Paste the key numbers and which slices regressed?
maya: Raw small-sample numbers (avg):
```
p50: 68ms (int8) / 63ms (int4)
p95: 410ms (int8) / 370ms (int4)
p99.9: 1.1s (int8) / 1.9s (int4)  # tail spike w/ KV churn
avg tokens/req: 120
cost per 1k tokens: $0.007 (int8) / $0.005 (int4)
quality delta - multi-turn-recall: int4 -9% F1, -10% ROUGE-L
quality delta - single-turn instruct: int4 -2% accuracy
```
zoe: Observed increased hallucinations in conv-QA for int4 during manual QA.
lee: Infra note: int4 uses a different kernel path that reduces memory but worsens tail when KV cache evictions are frequent. Could be mitigated with short cache retention bump or pinning.
sam: From product: GTN cares about perceived chat quality; we shouldn't default chat to int4. Batch tasks (embeddings, summarization) fine for int4.
product-rachel: Proposal: default chat -> meridian-9b-int8; use int4 for background/batch; premium users pinned to int8. Canary 10% traffic for 72h and monitor.
maya: Suggested hybrid routing config (ops):
```
routing:
  default: meridian-9b-int8
  fallback: meridian-9b-int4
  rules:
    - if prompt_tokens > 512 -> meridian-9b-int8
    - if workload in ["summarization","batch-embed"] -> meridian-9b-int4
    - if user_tier == "premium" -> meridian-9b-int8
    - monitor: slice("multi-turn-recall") -> alert if quality_drop > 5%
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: initiating canary rollout (10%) -> meridian-9b-int8 on prod-us-west-2. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollout/1732109876
maya: Canary 72h. Need these signals: p95/p99 latency, cost delta, slice-level quality for multi-turn-recall, conv-QA, longform-coherence, instr-following.
ev: I'll wire eval harness + realtime watchers and add regression alerts (trigger if quality delta > 5% on any primary slice). ETA 6h.
zoe: I'll do a 200-sample qualitative review on the int4 holdback for the listed slices and flag hallucinations. ETA 24h.
lee: Ops action: capture KV-cache hit rates, SM/CPU util, and 99.9 tail. Rollback int4 routing if 99.9 > 2s. ETA 12h for telemetry patch.
maya: Interim decision: canary int8 default (10%); keep int4 for batch/embs in a holdback pool; DO NOT route free chat to int4. Reassess after 72h with collected signals.
sam: Action items:
- evan: dashboards + regression alert (ETA 6h)
- zoe: qualitative pass on int4 holdback (ETA 24h)
- lee: telemetry for KV cache + tail alerts (ETA 12h)
- maya: draft GTN recommendation doc post-canary (ETA post-72h)
product-rachel: Thanks, keep product looped for any >3% regression.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started at 1732109890. Traffic split: 10%.
maya: 44d I'll post a short update after the first 12h sample.
